content.question: Hypothetical video-analysis app: compare guided setup, an interactive example, and contextual help for first-use onboarding. Which practical first version fits?
content.desired_output: A practical recommendation, alternatives and trade-offs, explicit supporting contribution/source IDs, responses to material challenges, unresolved concerns and evidence limits. Discuss only; no implementation.
content.constraints: Hypothetical product. One engineer-week. Never upload user videos; local/offline operation preferred. Keyboard and screen-reader accessibility matter. Compare meaningful trade-offs and identify an important open question for the team. Do not implement, assign Tasks, publish, spend or claim user testing occurred. Public research is unavailable; use supplied material.
content.recommendation: Proposed first version: a bounded interactive example, not a wizard or help-only screen. From the empty workspace, provide a keyboard-reachable offline entry to a bundled, explicitly synthetic/precomputed sample result. Let the user select one finding and inspect its time/region and plain-language meaning; keep a separate local-video route visible and state that personal videos are never uploaded. This meets the owner's no-network, no-personal-video, keyboard-only first useful action only if 'useful' means interpreting an output, not running analysis. It is a discussion recommendation, not an owner decision.
content.alternatives: Guided setup sequences steps but still needs a no-import branch and adds state/focus complexity under one engineer-week. Contextual help is cheap and useful alongside controls but alone does not overcome the empty workspace or provide the required action. Full bundled-video processing demonstrates the actual pipeline, but packaging, offline decoding, deterministic behavior, progress/errors, playback, and accessibility increase one-week risk. A static local walkthrough is a transparent fallback if accessible inspection is infeasible, but is less useful and must not be called interactive.
content.supporting_findings: The hypothetical brief establishes local short-video analysis, an empty first-use workspace, one engineer-week, and no analytics, interviews, or confirmed accessibility evaluation (evidence_1dcea2d5-e545-4db5-9591-bb51fdd6a2be). The later owner constraint requires a keyboard-only first useful action without network or personal video (cmessage_103518e0-641f-42ff-a32c-b1abd02e7e6d). Linus proposed the bounded offline sample and separate local-video route (cmessage_c127d1d0-36a1-4730-ae62-251b8b7e9b65); Grace clarified that one meaningful interpretive action is required rather than a static screenshot (cmessage_e579f809-cf60-4741-8d36-9d5a4efc0874). Turing revised from guided setup to the conditional sample recommendation (cmessage_928201df-f7e1-474b-a034-be8194485609). Maya similarly revised her local-file-first preference (cmessage_2bd1aa43-0424-4137-82ad-d7683dfe30af).
content.challenges_addressed: A local-file-first path fails the later no-personal-video condition; the bundled result solves that narrower issue. A precomputed result risks implying live analysis, so label it plainly and explain that it teaches interpretation, not execution. A merely static example may not be a useful action; require keyboard-operated finding selection with a text-equivalent explanation. A full real-processing demo is more faithful but has materially greater unverified effort and accessibility scope.
content.dissent_and_risks: No participant maintains a competing preferred first version after the owner constraint, but support is conditional. The important unresolved question is whether first use must execute offline analysis on bundled media or merely interpret a precomputed finding; the recommendation satisfies only the latter. If there is no reusable result view or suitable synthetic finding, even the bounded example may exceed one engineer-week. A static fallback may fail the owner's intended meaning of useful.
content.missing_evidence_and_confidence: Moderate confidence in comparative design fit, low confidence in one-week feasibility or user benefit. No component inventory, effort estimate, analytics, interviews, user testing, or accessibility evaluation is supplied; the brief is hypothetical, not production observation, and public research is unavailable. Missing validation: complete network-off/no-import keyboard traversal, activation, visible focus, absence of traps, predictable return; representative screen-reader names, headings/order, selection announcements, and understandable text independent of sight, sound, or color, ideally with assistive-technology users.
content.next_actions_and_approvals: For team/owner decision: clarify whether the target first action is interpretation or actual execution, and separately confirm whether a reusable result view and synthetic finding exist. Any implementation, accessibility validation, assignment, or approval would require separate authorization; none is claimed or initiated here.
content.authority: Proposed recommendation; no owner decision, implementation assignment or protected approval is implied.

content.recommendation: Proposed one-engineer-week first version: a bounded interactive example. In the empty workspace, offer a keyboard-reachable, offline entry to a bundled, explicitly synthetic and precomputed sample result; let the user select one finding and inspect its time/region and plain-language meaning. Keep a separate local-video route visible and state that personal videos are never uploaded. This provides a no-network, no-personal-video first useful action only if usefulness means interpreting an output, not executing the analysis pipeline. The brief's candidate interactive example uses bundled synthetic media; this narrower precomputed-result proposal must not be represented as live processing or validation of the pipeline. Discussion recommendation only, not an owner decision.
content.alternatives: Guided setup sequences the real workflow, but a personal-video selection cannot be its sole first action under the later owner constraint; a no-import branch plus wizard state and focus management add scope. Contextual help is comparatively small and useful beside controls, but by itself supplies no concrete first-use action. Running actual offline analysis on bundled synthetic media is more faithful to the brief's interactive-example candidate and teaches execution, but asset packaging, decoding/determinism, progress/error states, playback and accessibility create greater unverified one-week risk. A static local sample walkthrough is a transparent lower-scope fallback if accessible inspection cannot fit, but may not meet the intended useful-action bar and must not be called interactive.
content.supporting_findings: The owner-supplied hypothetical brief identifies local short-video analysis, an empty workspace, three candidates, one engineer-week, and absence of analytics, interviews or confirmed accessibility evaluation (evidence_1dcea2d5-e545-4db5-9591-bb51fdd6a2be). The later owner constraint requires the first useful action with keyboard only, no network and no personal-video import (cmessage_103518e0-641f-42ff-a32c-b1abd02e7e6d). Linus proposed the bounded offline sample and separate local-video route (cmessage_c127d1d0-36a1-4730-ae62-251b8b7e9b65); Grace required genuine interpretive interaction rather than a screenshot (cmessage_e579f809-cf60-4741-8d36-9d5a4efc0874); Turing conditionally revised from guided setup (cmessage_928201df-f7e1-474b-a034-be8194485609); Maya revised her earlier local-file-first preference (cmessage_2bd1aa43-0424-4137-82ad-d7683dfe30af). content.challenges_addressed: The original local-file-first proposal cannot satisfy the later no-personal-video first-action requirement; the sample path addresses that specific gap. A precomputed result could falsely imply analysis ran, so explicit labeling and honest explanation are essential. A static screenshot or tooltips alone do not deliver the proposed meaningful action; selecting a finding and reading a text-equivalent explanation does. A full bundled-media execution demo better demonstrates the true workflow, but the added technical and accessibility scope makes it a riskier one-week choice absent component evidence. Keyboard reachability alone is not accessibility validation.
content.dissent_and_risks: No participant retains a competing preferred first version after the later constraint; support for the bounded example is conditional, not unanimous proof of feasibility. The central unresolved product question is whether first use must demonstrate actual offline analysis of bundled synthetic media or merely allow interpretation of a precomputed synthetic finding. If the former, the recommendation is insufficient. If no reusable accessible result view or suitable synthetic finding exists, even the narrowed example may exceed one engineer-week. Static fallback may fail the intended first-use value.

The brief is hypothetical owner-supplied material, not observed production evidence; no component inventory, measured estimate, analytics, interviews, user testing, or accessibility evaluation is supplied, and public research is unavailable. Needed validation before any accessibility claim: complete offline/no-import keyboard traversal and activation, visible focus, no traps, predictable focus return; representative screen-reader accessible names, headings, reading order and selected-finding/change announcements; text-equivalent meaning without sight, sound, color or playback, including assessment with assistive-technology users. None is reported.
content.next_actions_and_approvals: For a separate owner/team decision, resolve whether the required first useful action is interpretation or actual pipeline execution; inspect existing result-view/sample assets and estimate the accessible scope against one engineer-week; validate the no-network/no-import keyboard and screen-reader path before claiming accessibility. turns.output: {"body":"I support a sample-first first use, provisionally. Define the first outcome as a clearly synthetic, bundled local example that lets someone perform one core action, see an immediate result, and then repeat the same action on their own local data without an account or network. Because the product is hypothetical, the specific action cannot yet be named; if its core value requires sensitive input or irreversible changes, use a read-only preview instead of preloading a sample. This answers Turing's question in cmessage_5af5cd7d-437f-4054-88b1-8f20018c5499 only at the pattern level, not as a product fact. Compared with a wizard, this reduces steps and likely engineering/accessibility state under the one-engineer-week constraint, but may under-explain complex prerequisites. Compared with documentation-only, it makes the first successful action discoverable, but risks a misleading demo if sample and real workflows diverge. content.question: Use public software onboarding/documentation patterns to recommend a practical first-use approach for a small offline-capable tool. Compare evidence and trade-offs.
content.desired_output: A practical recommendation, alternatives and trade-offs, explicit supporting contribution/source IDs, responses to material challenges, unresolved concerns and evidence limits. Discuss only; no implementation.
content.constraints: Atlas: choose an appropriate team from existing eligible workers. Only Atlas has an explicit public research grant. Investigate a material public question using your own bounded search queries; retrieve and share relevant evidence from at least two distinct public sources with the managed reader when available. Distinguish retrieved page content from search snippets. Other participants should inspect the shared exports and evaluate their relevance and limits. Discuss specific earlier contributions when clarification is worthwhile. Hypothetical product, one engineer-week, privacy and accessibility constraints. No implementation, publication, hiring or implied approvals.
content.recommendation: Proposed decision rule, not approval: default to a concise bundled/offline quickstart with prominent direct local-data entry. Add only a tiny optional, visibly synthetic sample path if the existing real workflow's core action can be demonstrated on disposable bundled data with identical controls and result semantics, no account/network/sensitive input or silent persistence/import/upload/telemetry, reversible state, and keyboard/screen-reader/non-color comprehension verified within one engineer-week. If that gate fails, consider a truthful read-only preview; if even that misrepresents the workflow, retain quickstart plus direct entry alone. Keep any first-run choice nonblocking and small.
content.supporting_findings: GitHub Desktop retrieved-page excerpt describes tutorial repository alongside clone/new/existing-local choices (evidence_9feee189-a47f-4118-be74-64858c0b9d7a); VS Code retrieved-page excerpt describes Welcome-page self-guided walkthroughs and progress (evidence_1a80488c-6c5c-45b3-8c12-baa7f8c286a6). They support optional guided help beside direct action as analogies, not sample efficacy. Maya's conditional gate is cmessage_dc7b9733-937d-427e-bdf2-d0ce634ac6f7; Grace's safety fallback is cmessage_4c4d5254-857f-485c-b75a-c48e3b5fd928; Turing's one-week feasibility revision is cmessage_052cc5b2-1b1f-4807-aa8d-fa1eb4930b43. Hypothetical constraints are evidence_287df641-32ea-4e5f-a92c-99299319866e.
content.alternatives: Unconditional interactive sample offers experiential learning but may teach a false workflow, risk privacy, and exceed accessibility/offline budget. Three-way first-run choice provides clear options but each branch adds copy, focus, labeling and packaging work; use only if nearly free atop existing paths. Read-only preview is safer when truthful but cannot demonstrate an actual outcome. Quickstart/direct entry is lowest complexity, at cost of greater discovery burden. Multi-step wizard can explain mandatory prerequisites or consent, but otherwise imposes disproportionate branching and test cost. Docs-only is cheapest but least discoverable.
content.challenges_addressed: Atlas asked whether a representative reversible action can be named; without product category, inputs or effect it cannot, so the recommendation is conditional rather than invented (cmessage_6b391a8f-48a7-4146-ab4f-5b2f34c376f9; cmessage_dc7b9733-937d-427e-bdf2-d0ce634ac6f7). Atlas's first-run choice is an inference from documentation examples, not validated outcomes; Grace examined both exports and limited the claim (cmessage_4c4d5254-857f-485c-b75a-c48e3b5fd928). Turing answered the final cost challenge by rejecting an automatic three-way choice and revising his own sample-first presumption (cmessage_052cc5b2-1b1f-4807-aa8d-fa1eb4930b43).
content.dissent_and_risks: No substantive unresolved disagreement among the three response contributions; earlier sample-first leanings were explicitly revised. Atlas facilitated and contributed public evidence but his attempted synthesis turn was blocked by runtime deadline, so there is no completed Atlas synthesis or owner endorsement. Risks: misleading preview/sample, branch complexity, privacy leakage, inaccessible onboarding, and making offline claims without tests. Missing owner product specifics prevent selecting an actual sample or declaring the design feasible.
content.missing_evidence_and_confidence: Moderate confidence in the conservative decision rule; low confidence in comparative efficacy or product-specific feasibility. Public sources are narrow retrieved-page excerpts from two distinct pages, retrieved around 10:01 UTC, not search snippets; publication and observation dates unknown. They contain no user outcomes and do not establish this hypothetical tool's offline operation, accessibility, sample-to-real transfer or one-week cost. Product category, core task, existing UI architecture, representative safe data, user research and actual offline/accessibility tests are unknown. All four named participants contributed, but final synthesis participation was incomplete because Atlas's synthesis attempt failed; no owner decision is recorded.
content.next_actions_and_approvals: Discussion only. Owner would need separately to specify product/core workflow and decide whether to authorize any work. If pursued later, validate the representative-action gate, offline packaging, privacy behavior and keyboard/screen-reader/non-color use within the stated budget before choosing sample versus fallback; seek owner approval and formal assignment outside this discussion. No implementation, publication, hiring or financial action is authorized.
content.authority: Proposed recommendation; no owner decision, implementation assignment or protected approval is implied.
